title: Legacy plans: Developer, Business, Enterprise On-Ramp

kcs.statement: Legacy Developer Support gives business-hours email access to technical support, with responses in under 24 business hours for general guidance and under 12 business hours for an impaired system, suited to testing and early development.

Legacy Business Support gives 24/7 phone, chat and email technical support and all Trusted Advisor checks, with responses in under 4 hours for an impaired production system and under 1 hour for a production system that is down.
Legacy Enterprise On-Ramp targets under 30 minutes for a business-critical system down and gives access to a pool of technical account managers rather than a designated one.

problem_ideas: An exam item lists Developer, Business, Enterprise On-Ramp and Enterprise: which is cheapest for a 1-hour response when production is down?
